verdict.rationale: The support reference states that llamafile ships GPU acceleration for both AMD and Vulkan, so a first-party Vulkan backend exists. Nothing in the pack says Vulkan can drive AMD GPUs without a ROCm install, and there is no hands-on report of Vulkan acceleration on AMD hardware. Older community comments about needing dev tools for GPU concern CUDA and are not a concrete contradiction of Vulkan support. missing for 10: documentation that the Vulkan backend accelerates AMD GPUs without ROCm, setup or flag details for selecting Vulkan, independent or hands-on corroboration of Vulkan-on-AMD performance

support.subject: As a power-user, I can accelerate inference on AMD GPUs via a Vulkan backend without needing a full ROCm install

citations.quote: llamafile ships GPU acceleration for Apple Metal, NVIDIA, AMD, and Vulkan.
